Class InventoryDAO

java.lang.Object
InventoryDAO
public class InventoryDAO extends Object
Database calls for the manager GUI (model side of MVC). fetchAll() - every Inventory row, ordered by name updateQuantities() - batch update of Quantity for a set of items (one transaction) insertItem() - add a new Inventory row; InventoryID = MAX + 1 fetchInactiveItems() - every inactive Inventory row, ordered by name reactivateInventoryItem() - restore a previously deleted Inventory row by setting its Active flag to TRUE discontinueInventoryItem() - remove a previously active Inventory row by setting its Active flag to FALSE fetchMenuItems() - every MenuItem row, ordered by MenuItemID updatePrices() - batch update of Price for a set of menu items (one transaction) insertMenuItem() - add a new MenuItem row; MenuItemID = MAX + 1 discontinueMenuItem() - remove a previously active MenuItem row by setting its Active flag to FALSE A new price applies to orders placed after it is saved. Past orders are not touched: their totals are already stored in Orders.Total. The threshold column is Minimum_Threshold in the live database (see generate_base_data.cpp), even though the CHANGELOG calls it MinimumThreshold.

      quantity - starting quantity
